name: Chalk Burst
description: Crush a charged chalk mark underfoot so that it bursts forward in a hard puff of qi.

name: Cord Plait
description: Weave three cords of qi round a foe's leg and draw them tight as he steps.

name: Tab Ward
description: Slap a charged paper tab on the sleeve and let it spread a ward over the whole arm.

name: Chalk Sense
description: Scatter chalk of qi across the floor and read the footprints that disturb it.

name: Drill Hop
description: Hop between three marks laid in a triangle so that each landing carries the body to the next.

name: Chain Anchor
description: Link two anchors with a cord of qi and hold it taut so it binds the foe and screens the maker.

name: Flare Ring
description: Break a drawn ring all at once so that its stored qi flares outward in a flat hard wave.

name: Wright Circle
description: Close a ring of runes about the body so a blow must break each rune in turn.

name: Rune Bolt
description: Loose a bolt of qi from a drawn rune so it flies straight and cracks on the target.

name: Arc Sweep
description: Sweep an arc of qi along the ground to trip a foe who runs across it.

name: Cinder Glyph
description: Leave a glyph that smoulders faintly and shows by its heat where a body has just passed.

name: Even Stride
description: Lay runes at the heel in a line so each stride lands light and the pace holds.

name: Rune Charge
description: Hold a rune against the breastbone and let it pour a steady charge of qi into the arms.

name: Braced Ward
description: Brace a drawn ward with runes at its corners so it turns a heavy blow aside and stays whole.

name: Twin Rune
description: Flare two runes together so a short wave of qi throws the foes back and scatters their holds.

name: Key Stamp
description: Stamp a keyed seal on a lid or a strap so it opens only to the maker's qi.

name: Latch Seal
description: Fix a latch seal on the forearm so that the arm is locked firm against a blow.

name: Tell Seal
description: Leave a seal on a bundle that flushes bright when any hand but the maker's lifts it.

name: Hasp Strike
description: Snap a closed seal against the foe's ribs so that its held qi bursts open inside the blow.

name: Locking Ring
description: Close a keyed ring about a foe's wrists and hold it shut until the maker lets the key go.

name: Keyed Burst
description: Tear a seal open in a stranger's grip so that its held qi bursts outward and breaks the hold.

name: Loop Feed
description: Close a loop of qi around the chest so the qi circles back and feeds each next breath.

name: Quick Loop
description: Whip a half-closed loop across the foe's guard so that it snaps shut on the arm.

name: Round Carry
description: Give a blow a path of qi that carries it round the body and out the far side.

name: Gap Reader
description: Feel along a loop for the gap where another's qi leaks in and learn how it moves.

name: Spark Leap
description: Cross a gap between two loops in one quick leap carried by the charge between them.

name: Bound Loop
description: Drop a closed loop over a foe's arm and tighten it with each breath the maker takes.

name: Closed Loop
description: Shut a loop about the body so the ward feeds on blows and returns a measure to the maker.

name: Surge Coil
description: Wind a loop tight and let it go so its stored qi surges outward in a ring.

name: Cut Current
description: Cut a foe's loop of qi at its weakest point so that the foe's own current dies down.

name: Weave Guard
description: Weave strands of qi in front of the chest so that a blow must tear through each strand.

name: Anchor Throw
description: Throw a weighted anchor of qi that lands hard and drags the foe's feet short.

name: Hold Weave
description: Spread a woven net of qi over a foe's feet and keep it drawn tight.

name: Beacon Stone
description: Set a stone that shines in the maker's sense whenever a body passes within a few paces.

name: Tethered Stride
description: Pull the body along a cord anchored ahead so that the stride lengthens by a pace.

name: Anchor Net
description: Cast several anchors outward on cords that fall as a net and catch every leg beneath them.

name: Weighted Weave
description: Weigh a woven ward with anchors so it holds its ground and presses down on those who push.
